name: io.github.cachepin/cachepin
description: Zero-dependency Rust + AVX2 lossless multi-agent LLM prompt-cache compiler, exact O(M^2 K) mixed-TTL breakpoint solver, trace forensics auditor, and Shadow-KV router simulator.

tools.name: optimize_prompt
tools.description: Losslessly canonicalize an Anthropic/OpenAI LLM request payload (deterministic JSON keys, sorted tools, bijective volatile hoisting, All-Gather alignment) and compute exact O(M^2 K) mixed-TTL cache breakpoints.

tools.name: diagnose_diff
tools.description: Run AVX2 byte-level prefix divergence forensics between two consecutive prompts, classifying root cause and USD waste.

tools.name: plan_breakpoints
tools.description: Solve exact constrained mixed-TTL (1h before 5m, K <= 4) cache breakpoints and 270s keepalive break-even.

tools.name: audit_trace
tools.description: Audit a JSONL request trace or Claude Code ~/.claude/projects transcript directory for cache misses and counterfactual USD savings.

tools.name: route_simulate
tools.description: Simulate multi-backend Shadow-KV adaptive-replication routing against Round-Robin, Least-Loaded, Consistent-Hash, and SingleHome-2xDivert.
